tickets.title: Habit schema and append-only event store
tickets.provides: Canonical habit + check-in event schema with an append-only store the rest of the app reads through

tickets.title: Streak computation service
tickets.provides: Pure service that folds a check-in event stream into current + longest streak per habit

tickets.title: Daily check-in REST endpoints
tickets.provides: POST /api/v1/habits/{id}/checkins and GET today's board for the signed-in member

tickets.title: Weekly digest email
tickets.provides: Monday-morning per-member digest summarizing last week's streaks and misses

tickets.title: Habit heatmap calendar view
tickets.provides: GitHub-style contribution heatmap rendering per-habit check-in density over the last year

tickets.title: Shared team rituals with roles
tickets.provides: Team-scoped rituals with owner/member roles so a lead can curate shared habits
